## Critique
- claim-1: Correct conditional on the accepted integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation. The listed columns are complete, and the displayed rows generate the full product lattices in degrees \(d+1\) and \(d+2\). The conclusions \(Q_d\cong\mathbb Z\bar x_0\), \(Q_{d+1}\cong\mathbb Z\bar x_1\), and \(Q_{d+2}\cong\mathbb Z\bar x_2\) follow integrally.
- claim-2: Correct. The complementary minor
  \[
  \begin{pmatrix}1&1&1\\1&1&0\\0&1&1\end{pmatrix}
  \]
  has determinant \(1\), proving that the row lattice is unimodularly complementary to the retained \(x_2\)-column. The requested opposite-boundary truncated certificate is therefore established. No conclusion in degrees \(>d+2\) follows.
